faq.q: Can I start at 60 kW and upgrade later?
faq.a: Yes. The base unit has two 30 kW modules. Two more can be added in the field to reach 120 kW, inside the same cabinet.

faq.q: Can both guns charge at the same time?
faq.a: Yes. Power is shared between the two guns in module steps, so two vehicles charge at once and power moves to whichever needs it.
Vehicles with a CCS2 (Combo-2) inlet, which most new electric cars in India use, from 150 to 1000 V DC. Compatibility for buses and commercial vehicles is confirmed per model.

faq.q: 180 kW or 240 kW: which do I need?
faq.a: It depends on how many vehicles charge at once, how long they stop and the supply at your site. We size it after a site assessment.

faq.q: Will my site need a new transformer?
faq.a: Often, at this power. The unit draws up to 270 kVA. The survey covers available load, DISCOM approvals and transformer or civil works, and the quote lists them separately.

faq.q: Will it work with our charging software?
faq.a: It speaks OCPP 1.6J, the open protocol most CMS and CPMS platforms use, and can be upgraded to OCPP 2.x. It can also run on the Envizon EV digital platform.

items.q: Do you only supply chargers, or install them too?
items.a: Both. We supply chargers alone, supply and install, or deliver the whole site turnkey: feasibility, design, procurement, civil and electrical works, commissioning and handover.

items.q: What happens during a site assessment?
items.a: We check demand, site access and power availability, the parking layout, cable routes and the civil and electrical scope, then recommend chargers and a phased plan.

items.q: Who handles DISCOM approvals and transformer upgrades?
items.a: We include them in the survey and list them separately in the quote, so you can see what the chargers cost and what the site needs.

items.q: Can we start small and add capacity later?
items.a: Yes. NEO chargers take extra power modules in the field, and we design the electrical scope for expansion, so growth does not mean starting over.

items.q: What support do you provide after launch?
items.a: Remote monitoring, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting and 24/7 support, with AMC and managed-operations options agreed in the contract.
